user.title: mBenzin access key
user.description: Enter your personal mBenzin key. mBenzin gives it free to Home Assistant users: e-mail reklama@mbenzin.cz, say what the prices are for, which city/stations and how often you load them. Never share the key.

city.title: City
city.description: Only the stations of this city are shown.

fuels.title: Fuels
fuels.description: Pick one or more fuels (for example Natural 95 + LPG for a dual-fuel car). Each fuel makes its own sensors.

station.title: Favourite station – {fuel}
station.description: Your usual station in {city} for {fuel}. It gets its own sensor with price history and trends. Leave "—" for none.

error.invalid_auth: The key was not accepted by mBenzin.
error.rate_limited: mBenzin returned HTTP 429 (limit of 20 pages per hour). Try again later.
